expected_component.value: large cleaned 167-language web corpus with Ukrainian stratum

upstream_observation.observation_limit: Upstream aggregate counts are descriptive only and are not 12-6 corpus evidence.

facts: CulturaX says its license terms strictly follow mC4 and OSCAR.
Records expose timestamp, url, and source provenance fields.
The card warns personal and sensitive information may remain.
The gated access text requires a jurisdiction/use-case legality confirmation and no re-identification.
mC4 is derived from Common Crawl.
The dataset card states ODC-BY terms and also binds use to Common Crawl terms for contained content.
OSCAR states CC0 applies to packaging, metadata and annotations.
OSCAR states its authors do not own the crawled text.
OSCAR exposes jurisdiction/copyright-use caveats rather than blanket text ownership.
Crawled Content may be subject to separate terms from content owners.
Use must comply with applicable law and respect third-party rights.
The terms include privacy-related restrictions for Crawled Content.

ua_en_feasibility.relative_scale_observation: English is far larger than Ukrainian in CulturaX declared token counts; both are only upstream descriptive capacity.

legal clearance for all underlying web text

required_before_any_training_credit: Pin an immutable CulturaX dataset revision and enumerate exact selected en/uk files.
Record exact file identities, sizes and checksums before preprocessing.
Retain per-record source, url and timestamp provenance into immutable intake manifests.
Partition and report mC4 versus each OSCAR release instead of collapsing inherited source authority.
Apply source-level rights/terms classification; never infer text ownership from CulturaX, ODC-BY or CC0 packaging metadata.
Re-check current Common Crawl, mC4, OSCAR, CulturaX access, jurisdiction and use-case terms at acquisition time.
Run privacy/PII risk processing and preserve evidence of removals/quarantine without asserting perfect PII elimination.
Apply reserved-evaluation decontamination before any training eligibility decision.
Run exact/near cross-source deduplication and no-replay accounting against the terminal corpus lineage.
Compute admitted source bytes and unique causal-loss positions only from locally verified, rights-approved, decontaminated terminal artifacts.
Freeze machine-readable manifests and two-clean-build determinism evidence before Research Corpus V1 promotion.
successor_acquisition_contract.promotion_rule: No CulturaX byte receives canonical training credit until every required gate is terminal and fail-closed.
successor_acquisition_contract.owner_handoff: D03 may build an acquisition/qualification package; AUDIT-B independently rechecks the resulting exact artifacts.
